name: GUADALUPE
description: Guadalupe is a manipulation rummy game where players can reorganize existing melds on the table to form new combinations. Players draw 1-2 cards and must meld, or draw 3 cards without melding. Part of the Carousel/Machiavelli family of rummy games where table cards can be rearranged.

content.text: Guadalupe is a manipulation rummy game where players can reorganize existing melds on the table to form new combinations. Players draw 1-2 cards and must meld, or draw 3 cards without melding. Part of the Carousel/Machiavelli family of rummy games where table cards can be rearranged.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Mid-20th century
Creator(s): John Scarne (described in Encyclopedia of Card Games, 1973)
Etymology: Named after Guadalupe; exact origin of name unclear

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 5
Optimal Players: 3-4
Partnerships: No

Type: Standard 52-card
Number of Decks: 1 for 2 players (53 with joker), 2 for 3-5 players (106 with 2 jokers)

Cards per Player: 10
Dealing Pattern: Standard clockwise deal
Remaining cards form stock pile
